title: Merchandise Purchases Price Adjustment Policy
content:
**§1 Lower Marlowe & Finch price.** When Marlowe & Finch — any store, mfinch.com or the app — sells the identical item (the same item number) at a lower price within the price-adjustment window, the customer may ask for the difference on a Merchandise Purchases unit.

**§2 Window.** The request date is no later than the price adjustment window after the purchase date. The window is the class's price adjustment window plus the price adjustment extension days of the customer's Finch Circle tier held on the request date (as kept by the Finch Circle Loyalty Program), counted in calendar days with the purchase date as day 0, and a request on the last day is in time. The window is read from the purchase date on the unit's own purchase record.

**§3 Class and kind of price.** The class must offer price adjustments. Lower prices of the excluded kinds never qualify — clearance markdowns, doorbusters, coupons or promo codes, competitor prices, final sale and bonus card offers — and a unit bought as clearance or final sale is never adjusted.

**§4 Status of the unit.** The unit is in ordered, shipped or completed status.
*This clause is no longer in force for a registry price protection claim; every other price adjustment keeps this status condition.*

**§5 Limit and smallest difference.** The number of price-drop adjustments already recorded on the purchase record is below the class's per-item maximum, and the per-unit difference between the unit's effective price — the new unit price of the latest price adjustment recorded on the purchase record, or its selling price when it has none — and the new lower price is at least the class's smallest refundable difference.
*This clause is no longer in force for a registry price protection claim; every other price-drop adjustment remains under it.*

**§6 Amount and tender.** The adjustment refunds that difference plus the sales tax charged on it — the unit's sales tax times the difference divided by the unit's selling price, rounded half up to the cent — to the original tender, never as a gift card.
*This clause is no longer in force for a registry price protection claim; every other price-drop adjustment remains under it.*

**§7 Register price errors.** A register price error adjustment — the unit was charged above its ticketed or advertised price on the purchase date — is made at any time while the unit is not returned, refunds the overcharge, and counts toward no limit.
*This clause is no longer in force for the following register errors, each of which is now governed by the current rule written for it: a unit rung above its shelf ticket; registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; the card money taken for a Finch Note recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid; gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; and a second capture of the same tender. Every other register error stays under this clause.*

**§8 Points and spend.** A price adjustment does not change Finch Circle points or qualifying spend.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Purchase date (day 0) | Class window | Finch Circle extension days | Last day | Request on | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 14 days | none | 15 May | 15 May | Yes |
| 1 May | 14 days | none | 15 May | 16 May | No |
| 1 May | 14 days | 7 days | 22 May | 22 May | Yes |

## Worked price-drop adjustment under §5 and §6 (hypothetical figures)

A unit with no earlier adjustment, bought at a selling price of $100.00 with $8.00 sales tax; the identical item later sells at $80.00, not an excluded kind of price. The difference is $20.00, at least the smallest refundable difference. The tax on it is $8.00 times $20.00 divided by $100.00, that is $1.60. The adjustment refunds $21.60 to the original tender. A later second request on the same unit measures its difference from $80.00, the new unit price of the latest adjustment.

## Points of judgement

- *A lower price from a competitor:* never qualifies (§3).
- *A unit that has been returned:* not in ordered, shipped or completed status, so §4 is not met for an ordinary price drop.
- *Points after an adjustment:* unchanged (§8).

superseded_clauses: A register_price_error adjustment (the unit was charged above its ticketed or advertised price on the purchase date) is made at any time while the unit is not returned, refunds the overcharge, and counts toward no limit.

The adjustment refunds that difference plus the sales tax charged on it (the unit's tax_amount times the difference divided by unit_price, rounded half up to the cent) to the original tender (price_adjustment_refund_tender), never as a gift card.

The order_msr_price_adjustments_on_unit count is below the class's price_adjustments_per_item_max, and the per-unit difference between order_msr_effective_unit_price and the new_unit_price is at least price_adjustment_min_difference_usd.
The unit is in ordered, shipped or completed status.
